title: EIT Changemaker Award 2025
excerpt: The Robot Study Companion took part in IEEE RO-MAN 2025, bringing together members of the RSC team for research presentations and the robot design competition.
content: Farnaz Baksh is redefining support for students worldwide. The Robot[ic] Study Companion is an affordable, open-source social robot that helps students stay motivated, organised and emotionally supported — key ingredients for academic success.
